management_notes: The May 2026 data-compilation correction to Frost Cove results remains the primary management credibility overhang. The company disclosed promptly, but corrected intercepts (FC25-17: 2.00% Sb over 0.10m; FC25-27: 13.00% Sb over 0.57m) showed substantially narrower widths than originally reported — a meaningful QA/QC failure for a single-asset explorer whose investment case rests entirely on drill data. The original headline numbers (7.25% Sb over 1.98m and 6.44% Sb over 2.06m) were the basis of significant market attention and their correction has materially reduced credibility on early-stage data. Orderly execution of the Golden Baie option (TSXV-approved March 2026, Canstar share consideration issued) and launch of the 2026 two-rig program demonstrate operational competence. Score cannot recover to 3 until at least one full clean disclosure cycle follows the QA/QC incident — the pending 2026 assay releases will be the first test.
geology_notes: The 2025 maiden drill program at Black Raven established high-grade antimony mineralisation at Frost Cove over approximately 800m strike — corrected standout intercepts include 7.25% Sb over 1.98m and 6.44% Sb over 2.06m near the Southern Shaft. The 2026 two-rig program has completed 9 holes targeting the northern strike extension (~500m untested) and the Pomley Cove Pond gold-silver-molybdenum-lead-zinc vein swarm (20 veins within 150m width confirmed by channel sampling). A press release title visible in a July 15 web search — 'Churchill Reports More High-Grade Gold and Silver Vein Results Near Past Producing Frost Cove Antimony Mine Including 17.3 g/t Au and 130 g/t Ag' — suggests partial vein results may have been released from Pomley Cove, but the content was inaccessible (403 on company website). No NI 43-101-compliant resource estimate exists for either property, which hard-caps the geology score at 3 regardless of intercept quality. Score advances to 4 upon filing of a compliant resource.
capital_notes: 316.7M shares issued and 342.8M fully diluted (per April 2026 interim MD&A extraction) is a heavy share structure for an early-stage explorer with no NI 43-101 resource. The 15.8M shares issued to Canstar as Golden Baie option consideration are included in the current outstanding count. Options total 23.45M (~7.4% dilution above issued); warrants are modest at 2.625M with no strike/expiry detail available from the extraction. No flow-through tranches were detected in the extracted filing data, though flow-through financing is structurally common for NL-domiciled explorers given the Newfoundland and Labrador Mineral Exploration Tax Credit — any 2026 equity raise funding the two-rig program would likely carry a 4-month hold-release overhang on FT tranches. Two active exploration programs (Black Raven + Golden Baie) sustain ongoing dilution pressure.
catalyst_notes: Catalyst density remains high as of 2026-07-15. A press release title visible in web search ('Churchill Reports More High-Grade Gold and Silver Vein Results Including 17.3 g/t Au and 130 g/t Ag') could not be accessed but suggests partial vein-assay newsflow from Pomley Cove Pond. The 9-hole 2026 Frost Cove northern extension drill assays remain unconfirmed from public sources. Additional pending catalysts: (1) systematic geophysics and trenching results from Golden Baie; (2) potential critical-mineral grant or federal partnership announcement leveraging Canada/US antimony designation; (3) strategic-partner or offtake inquiry driven by Beaver Brook's proximity and Western supply-chain urgency. Score 4 maintained — the binary assay event on the northern extension is still the highest-impact near-term catalyst. Score would revise to 5 on confirmed clean results expanding the corrected 2025 intercepts, or to 2 on a second data-quality failure.
acquisition_notes: No NI 43-101 resource exists on either Black Raven or Golden Baie, making P/NAV analysis impossible and nav_per_share accordingly null. Comparable Western-hemisphere antimony M&A transactions are scarce, limiting precedent benchmarking. The strategic rationale is qualitatively strong — consolidated Newfoundland antimony district, proximity to Beaver Brook (historic infrastructure, China Minmetals, care and maintenance), Western supply-chain urgency — but cannot be quantified without a compliant resource. The May 2026 QA/QC incident temporarily reduces appeal to a technical acquirer in due diligence. Score 2 reflects verifiable high-grade mineralisation and a strategic commodity but no quantifiable value anchor; advances to 3 upon a compliant resource filing.
analyst_summary: Churchill Resources remains one of the few TSXV-listed primary antimony explorers in Canada at a moment when antimony is designated critical in both Canada and the US. Its consolidated Newfoundland footprint — Black Raven plus the optioned Golden Baie (39,925 ha, 29 licences) — covers a district with proven historical production at Beaver Brook and high-grade corrected drill intercepts at Frost Cove (7.25% Sb over 1.98m, 13.00% Sb over 0.57m). As of 2026-07-15, a press release title visible in web search ('Churchill Reports More High-Grade Gold and Silver Vein Results Including 17.3 g/t Au and 130 g/t Ag') suggests partial vein results from the Pomley Cove Pond target have been released, though the content was inaccessible via 403. The 9-hole 2026 Frost Cove northern extension assays remain unconfirmed from accessible sources. Factor scores unchanged: management score held at 2 (QA/QC correction overhang), capital score held at 2 (316.7M issued / 342.8M fully diluted is heavy for a no-resource stage). WATCH maintained. A move to BUY requires both a clean NI 43-101 resource filing and a clean disclosure track record following the May 2026 correction. Confidence low pending confirmation of accessible assay newsflow.
